observed_current_public_state: English homepage currently advertises Transit Drivers at $17.00/hour and states applications are kept on file one year.
At least one current localized homepage still advertises drivers at $16.00/hour, creating compensation-message drift.
The /jobs surface is indexed with unrelated San Francisco technology roles such as VP Product, Product Manager and HR Representative, inconsistent with RTEC's actual transit recruiting.
The dedicated RTEC job board says full-time medical/life/dental after 60 days and 401-K retirement after 30 days, plus historical-style leave/vacation benefit bullets.

Current 2025 handbook confirms medical eligibility generally after 60 days but states 401-K eligibility depends on additional service requirements described in the Plan; therefore the website's 30-day retirement statement should be validated against the current plan booklet rather than treated as plan authority.
The live rendered job-board page exposes a Job Requirements link but no visible Application link, even though indexed/search text says applicants can apply online/download an application.
risks: Applicants can receive different starting-pay information depending on language/page.
Unrelated template/demo jobs can appear to be official RTEC vacancies.
Benefit eligibility statements can outlive the governing plan documents.
Missing or stale application links can push applicants toward old PDF/email/in-person workflows.
Search engines and agents may ingest stale public copy as current HR policy.
remediation_candidates: Define ADP ATS/current recruiting source as canonical for open requisitions and pay ranges where technically possible.
Drive homepage/job-board/localized job listings from one canonical openings feed.
Remove or disable Wix/demo /jobs content that is not an RTEC vacancy source.
Validate current 401-K eligibility against the plan booklet/provider before keeping the 30-day website claim.
Verify the online Application link and printable-application link on the rendered job-board page.
Add locale/version regression checks for pay, open roles, benefits, contact details and application URLs.
Use current job-description versions separately from application templates.
source_priority_rule: ATS/requisition records, current job descriptions, current plan documents and current handbook outrank website marketing copy when they conflict. Public pages remain authoritative evidence of what applicants currently see.
localized_pay_drift_note: Current indexed localized homepages show a $16.00/hour driver starting rate while the current English homepage shows $17.00/hour.
additional_drift: A translated bid-opportunities page still exposes a 2021 office-phone-system solicitation while the current English bid page has no active opportunities.
The generic /jobs page exposes unrelated San Francisco technology jobs, apparently production template/demo content.
